Asterixis is a clinical sign that describes the inability to maintain sustained posture with subsequent brief, shock like, involuntary movements. This sign is not pathognomonic for any condition.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe was given Lactulose and Rifamixin.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E4) What was the efficacy of each treatment intervention used for this patient? Identify the over and under diagnosis and over and under treatment issues in the management of this patient.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003EAns.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003EA.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003Ehigh protein diet (2eggs \/ day) for decreased albumin synthesis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EB. Air or water bed to prevent pressure bed sores in the dependent areas\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EC. Fluid restriction \u0026lt;1.5litres\/day so as to decrease of fluid dissemination into the extra vascular space\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003ED. Salt restriction \u0026lt;2.4gms\/day to prevent retention of water.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EE. Inj augmentin 1.2gm IV\/BD to prevent secondary bacterial infections\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EF. Inj pan 40 mg IV\/OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EG. Tab. Lasilactone (20\/50)mg BD ( combination of furosemide and aldactone to decrease pedal oedema\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIf SBP \u0026lt;90mmhg - to avoid excessive loss of fluid\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EI. Syp lactulose 15ml\/PO\/BD for hepatic encephalopathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EK. Tab udiliv 300mg\/PO\/BD contain Ursodeoxycholic acid as an active ingredient. It is used to dissolve gall stones in various liver-related disorders such as cirrhosis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EL. Syp.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Hepameiz 15 ml\/PO\/OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EM. IVF 1 NS slowly at 30ml\/hr to maintain hydration\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EN. Strict BP\/PR\/TEMP\/Spo2 CHARTING HOURLY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EP. Strict I\/O charting\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EQ.
